question: If the mean proportional of X and 250 is 50, then find the value of X.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Mean proportional between two numbers A and B is given by √(A × B).

Here, A = X and B = 250. Mean proportional = 50.

⇒ √(X × 250) = 50.

⇒ X × 250 = 50² = 2500 ⇒ X = 2500 ÷ 250 = 10.

∴ A
